reason: Targeted proposal to resolve the two independently assessable mechanisms; no operative IDs, source mappings or adoption.

goals.title: Unabhängige Chromosomenverteilung als Rekombination erläutern
goals.titleEn: Explain independent chromosome assortment as recombination
goals.description: Die lernende Person kann an vorgegebenen Meiose-Chromosomenmodellen erläutern, wie die voneinander unabhängige Verteilung der mütterlichen und väterlichen Chromosomen verschiedener homologer Paare neue Kombinationen der Erbinformation in Keimzellen erzeugt.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied chromosome models of meiosis to explain how the independent assortment of maternally and paternally inherited chromosomes from different homologous pairs produces new combinations of genetic information in gametes.
goals.providedContext: Correct chromosome/chromatid/parental-origin legend, at least two homologous pairs, given independent alternatives and correctly supplied gamete chromosome sets.

goals.title: Chromatidabschnittsaustausch als Rekombination erläutern
goals.titleEn: Explain exchange of chromatid segments as recombination
goals.description: Die lernende Person kann an vorgegebenen Meiose-Chromosomenmodellen erläutern, wie der Austausch entsprechender Abschnitte zwischen Nichtschwesterchromatiden homologer Chromosomen neue Kombinationen der Erbinformation in Keimzellen erzeugt.
goals.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied chromosome models of meiosis to explain how the exchange of corresponding segments between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes produces new combinations of genetic information in gametes.
goals.providedContext: Correct homologous-pair and sister/non-sister chromatid legend, corresponding marked regions, given before/after exchange and correctly supplied gamete chromosome sets.

outOfScope: Independent model construction or drawing from memory
Molecular crossing-over/repair, DNA sequence or protein-synthesis mechanisms
Recombination frequencies, genetic maps, probabilistic calculations or a2^n routine
Trisomy21/nondisjunction as a surrogate for recombination
